incident response team we have a critical operational post-mortem and mitigation plan for the kafka cluster partition leader rebalance failure during yesterday's traffic surge. first examine server dot properties in the config directory to confirm that auto-leader-rebalance-enable is set to true and verify that leader-imbalance-per-broker-percentage is configured to one percent. next check file reference at kafka-core slash partition assignor dot java in the kafka-core directory and inspect controller dot py in the cluster-manager package. the primary root cause was an unexpected network partition between availability zones us-east-1a and us-east-1b causing twenty-four brokers to simultaneously trigger leader elections across two thousand partitions. during the cascading election phase message production halted because min-insync-replicas was set to three while replica lag exceeded replica-lag-time-max-ms of ten thousand milliseconds. to remediate this cascade we must tune zookeeper session timeouts from eighteen seconds scratch that six seconds to thirty seconds and adjust group-initial-rebalance-delay-ms from three seconds to zero seconds for low latency consumer group handoffs. in addition update controller dot py to ensure that partition state machine transitions throttle concurrent leader reassignments to fifty partitions per second rather than unconstrained batch elections. under no circumstances should any engineer modify the unclean-leader-election-enable setting to true as that would risk catastrophic data loss across financial audit logs. the principal systems architect requires that all broker nodes configure socket-send-buffer-bytes to one megabyte and socket-receive-buffer-bytes to one megabyte to prevent tcp buffer starvation under high load. confirm that consumer applications utilizing the java client library implement backoff retries using exponential jitter starting at two hundred milliseconds capped at five thousand milliseconds. incident coordinators should also review the runbook in docs slash runbooks slash kafka underscore rebalance dot md to verify that manual topic partition rebalancing commands specify explicit throttle rates. furthermore the observability team must establish automated grafana alerts triggered when under-replicated-partitions count exceeds zero for more than three consecutive minutes. also verify that all broker nodes emit jmx metrics to datadog tracking active controller count and offline partition count with zero second reporting intervals. the data platform engineering manager confirmed that all storage volumes must maintain twenty percent free disk space before resuming high throughput bulk ingestion pipelines. network engineers must inspect edge load balancers to ensure tcp keepalive probes are enabled with an interval of thirty seconds and probe count of three. in addition verify that consumer group heartbeat threads execute on dedicated high priority cpu cores to avoid false positives during heavy garbage collection pauses. the billing ingestion pipeline must also configure consumer max-poll-interval-ms to three hundred thousand milliseconds to accommodate long running batch database transactions. do not execute broker rolling restarts during peak business hours between nine am and six pm eastern time without vice president approval. all schema registry client libraries must enable local in-memory schema caching with a maximum capacity of ten thousand schemas to minimize http request overhead. in addition security operations must audit ssl certificate expiration dates across all broker nodes and ensure automated rotation thirty days prior to expiration. site reliability engineers will execute simulated broker failure drills in staging next tuesday morning to validate that partition rebalancing completes in under forty-five seconds. the backup and disaster recovery team must confirm that mirror maker two replication lag between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below two seconds. furthermore log segment compaction threads must be configured with min-cleanable-dirty-ratio set to zero point five to avoid excessive disk io during active hours. client application connection pools must enforce idle connection timeouts of sixty seconds to prune orphaned tcp sockets. the platform security team requires mutual tls authentication between all producers and brokers using certificates issued by our internal vault pki. incident leads must also ensure that post-incident action items are tracked in jira with assigned engineering owners and target completion dates within two sprints. regarding our upcoming migration to kraft consensus architecture please inspect kraft dot properties in the metadata directory. confirm that controller-quorum-voters lists all five dedicated kraft controller nodes across independent rack topologies. verify that metadata log replication segment size is configured to sixty-four megabytes and metadata snapshot interval is set to one hour. all transactional producer applications must enforce enable-idempotence set to true with transaction-timeout-ms configured to thirty thousand milliseconds. in addition the jvm runtime flags on all broker instances must pin the g1 garbage collector with max-gc-pause-millis set to twenty milliseconds and initiating-heap-occupancy-percent set to forty-five percent to eliminate stop the world latency spikes during active partition movements. tiered storage offloading must be enabled for all historical topic partitions older than forty-eight hours streaming compressed segments directly to encrypted s3 buckets. the data governance team mandates that topic deletion operations require dual authorization signatures in the cluster administration portal. finally schedule a comprehensive architectural readiness review for friday morning at ten am with the infrastructure director to audit all verified configuration diffs and authorize rollout to the production cluster.

**INCIDENT REMEDIATION TASK**  
Confirm that the following configuration settings are in place to mitigate the kafka cluster partition leader rebalance failure during yesterday's traffic surge:  

- `auto-leader-rebalance-enable` is set to `true` and `leader-imbalance-per-broker-percentage` is configured to `1%`.  
- File references at `kafka-core/partition-assignor.java` and `cluster-manager/controller.py` are inspected for correctness.  
- The `zookeeper` session timeout is adjusted from `18` to `6` seconds and group-initial-rebalance-delay-ms is set to `0` seconds for low latency consumer group handoffs.  
- Controller dot `py` is updated to throttle concurrent leader reassignments to `50` partitions per second instead of `batch` elections.  
- `jmx` metrics are configured to trigger alerts when under-replicated-partitions count exceeds zero for more than three consecutive minutes.  
- All broker nodes emit `jmx` metrics to datadog tracking active controller count and offline partition count with zero second reporting intervals.  
- Schema registry client libraries are enabled with a maximum capacity of `ten thousand` schemas.  
- Security operations audit SSL certificate expiration dates across all nodes and automated rotation is scheduled thirty days prior to expiration.  
- Site reliability engineers execute simulated broker failure drills in staging next Tuesday morning.  
- Backup and disaster recovery team confirms mirror maker two replication lag between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below two seconds.  
- Log segment compaction threads are configured with `min-cleanable-dirty-ratio` set to `zero` to avoid excessive disk io during active hours.  
- Client application connection pools enforce idle connection timeouts of `60` seconds to prune orphaned sockets.  
- Platform security team mandates mutual TLS authentication between all producers and brokers using certificates issued by our internal vault pki.  
- Post-incident action items are tracked in Jira with assigned owners and target completion dates within two sprints.  

**REQUIRED ACTIONS**  
1. Verify `auto-leader-rebalance-enable` and `leader-imbalance-per-broker-percentage` are correctly configured.  
2. Confirm `zookeeper` session timeout and group-initial-rebalance-delay-ms are set to `0` seconds for low latency consumer group handoffs.  
3. Update controller dot `py` to throttle leader reassignments to `50` partitions per second instead of `batch` elections.  
4. Adjust `jmx` metrics to trigger alerts when under-replicated-partitions count exceeds zero for more than three consecutive minutes.  
5. Ensure all broker nodes emit `jmx` metrics to datadog tracking active controller count and offline partition count with zero second reporting intervals.  
6. Confirm schema registry client libraries enable local in-memory caching with a maximum capacity of `ten thousand` schemas.

8. Verify `site-replication-lag` between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below two seconds.  
9. Log segment compaction threads are configured with `min-cleanable-dirty-ratio` set to `zero` to avoid excessive disk io during active hours.  
10. Client application connection pools enforce idle connection timeouts of `60` seconds to prune orphaned sockets.  
11. Platform security team mandates mutual TLS authentication between all producers and brokers using certificates issued by our internal vault pki.  
12. Post-incident action items are tracked in Jira with assigned owners and target completion dates within two sprints.  

**NOTES**  
- No engineer can modify `unclean-leader-election-enable` as it would risk catastrophic data loss.  
- All broker nodes must configure socket-send-buffer-bytes to one megabyte and socket-receive-buffer-bytes to one megabyte to prevent tcp buffer starvation.

- All storage volumes must maintain twenty percent free disk space before resuming high throughput bulk ingestion pipelines.

- Data platform engineering manager confirms schema registry client libraries enable local in-memory caching with a maximum capacity of ten thousand schemas.  
- Security operations audit SSL certificate expiration dates across all nodes and automated rotation is scheduled thirty days prior to expiration.  
- Site reliability engineers execute simulated broker failure drills in staging next Tuesday morning.  
- Backup and disaster recovery team confirms mirror maker two replication lag between primary and secondary cloud regions remains below two seconds.  
- Log segment compaction threads are configured with `min-cleanable-dirty-ratio` set to `zero` to avoid excessive disk io during active hours.  
- Client application connection pools enforce idle connection timeouts of `60` seconds to prune orphaned sockets.  
- Platform security team mandates mutual TLS authentication between all producers and brokers using certificates issued by our internal vault pki.
